title: GIG-3189: Produce Progress Every Ten Percent
description: Logs produce stages and ~10% progress on download, sanitize, anonymize, and gzip so factory GitHub Actions is not silent for hours.

test_plan.description: Unit tests cover 10% progress boundaries and sanitizer byte ticks
Factory workflow template unbuffers produce output and installs pg_dump 17
steps: Run ngramx init-postmaclone-workflow --dataset earl-kendrick in an empty directory
Confirm the generated workflow installs postgresql-client-17
Confirm the produce step uses stdbuf and php -d output_buffering=Off

test_plan.description: mysqldump is not polled (Bugbot pipe hang)
steps: Confirm mysqlDump calls Process::run() and does not call runDumpProcess
Confirm runDumpProcess calls clearstatcache before filesize

test_plan.description: Generated workflow adds the PGDG apt repo
steps: Confirm the generated YAML contains apt.postgresql.org and postgresql-client-17
